answer: Each new identity is split into shards held by a reef of randomly drawn established agents, and it can act only when a quorum co-signs its work each epoch. Shards rotate every epoch, so a Sybil farm must corrupt a fresh random quorum per fake, per epoch - cost scales with the quorum, not the farm. Newcomers start in a frozen tundra where shards sit with the most distant holders; verified work thaws them toward closer custody, and the relic - the unique shard-set fingerprint - is voided on fraud, forcing a full restart.
